method: Read exact target snapshots, PR bodies and available package README/target comparisons/abstracts/bibliographies; run fresh searches for every assigned target; follow primary sources and compare hypotheses, conclusion and chronology. Previous AI novelty assertions were not treated as evidence.
decision_boundary: An existing complete target result warrants citation replacement; related, weaker, restricted or later work does not. Own earlier posting or a registry import of the same submitted work is not an independent duplicate.
summary: Only new independent complete match verified in the merged range: PR83/AIM556, Esra Sengelen Sevim. PR60/AIM010 was already replaced with Sundqvist. Twelve closed literature PRs already cite external solutions without a current hosted package. The other 39 merged targets have no verified earlier complete match in this audit.
limits: This is not a complete mathematical referee review of all submitted manuscripts.
Absence from these searches cannot certify novelty.
Some negative comparisons use primary abstracts or original theorem locators rather than a complete proof reading; every source states the inspection boundary.
Recent preprint source status and attributed result scope are distinguished from human or formal proof certification.
No repository files were edited; no commits, pushes, deletions or contributor messages were made by this audit context.
